_about: Cameras on the real YAM rig (duchamp3), measured 2026-10-25. Null = not measured yet. Sim counterpart: Menagerie yam_linear_4310.xml 'wrist_cam' (a RealSense D405, RGB + depth); EnvCfg.cam_spec replaces its field of view and mount pose with wrist.sim. The real wrist cameras are RGB only (no depth), 5:4. Right wrist calibrated (intrinsics + mount pose, wrist.right); left not yet. Device paths are in scripts/real/rig.py.

wrist.model: generic UVC webcam (Generic 'USB Camera', iSerial 'YHTek'; Realtek chip, USB 0bda:5883)
wrist._serial_note: both cameras report the same iSerial 'YHTek', so they are told apart by USB port only

sim._about: Read by EnvCfg.cam_spec (blind_insertion/assets/real_camera.py). Values of the RIGHT wrist camera (the policy arm). The policy image on both sides: undistort with the intrinsics, crop the largest square centred on the principal point (policy_crop_px), resize to cam_res; the sim renders a square at fovy_deg from pose_in_link6, so no principal-point offset is needed.
sim._pose_note: camera optical frame (OpenCV: +z along the optical axis, +y down) in the Menagerie YAM link_6 frame; {pos: [m], quat: [w, x, y, z]}. The model's D405 it replaces sat 29 mm away, 7 deg less downward.

wrist._calib_note: per arm, from scripts/real/calib.py (checkerboard 8x7 inner corners, 15 mm, flat on the table; camera pose by hand-eye on the Menagerie link_6 frame). intrinsics at 1280x1024 in pixels; distortion: OpenCV [k1, k2, p1, p2, k3]

quality._holdout_note: hand-eye hold-out reprojection; ~3.5 mm at 0.25-0.3 m, limited by the arm model (link lengths, joint offsets), not the camera

top.usb: USB 3 (5 Gbps) required for the SDK
top._intrinsics_note: factory calibration from the ZED SDK 5.2, rectified images (distortion removed); left and right identical

extrinsics_cam_in_right_base._note: ZED rectified-left optical frame (OpenCV) in the right arm base frame, via the static board (run_002)
